test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - Reasoning(Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All goods are services.

No service is a delivery.

**Conclusions:**

I. No good is a delivery.

II. Some goods are deliveries.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Given:**

**Statements:**

All goods are services.

No service is a delivery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa3836c11c35034622dddaf82a2bdefa86343f7d7be0e8f509d96f7ee3d6cfab.png] 

 

**Conclusions:**

I. No good is a deliver
